run_exit_test: run the ExitTest unittest suite to verify gRPC server and client clean exit behavior
test_running_server: test that a running gRPC server exits cleanly when the Python interpreter shuts down
test_unstarted_server: test that an unstarted gRPC server exits cleanly without hanging on interpreter exit
test_in_flight_unary_unary_call: test that an in-flight unary-unary gRPC call exits cleanly on SIGINT signal
cleanup_processes: call cleanup_processes to kill all tracked subprocesses registered during test execution
